subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should this PR define a public plugin verify contract now, and if so must provenance be strictly selected-release scoped or may it include clearly separated current package trust config?
rationale: This endpoint exposes plugin trust and security semantics that downstream install or review clients may automate on, while the broader vetted-community plugin trust RFC is still open.

options.title: Ship release-scoped verify endpoint
options.body: Require provenance to come only from the selected release and keep mutable package config out of the release provenance envelope.

options.title: Expose current config separately
options.body: Allow current trusted-publisher or package verification state only in a clearly named mutable package-config field with docs and tests.

options.title: Pause behind trust RFC
options.body: Keep the draft open until the vetted-community plugin trust RFC settles the public review-signal contract.

recommendation.title: Ship release-scoped verify endpoint
recommendation.body: Require provenance to come only from the selected release and keep mutable package config out of the release provenance envelope.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has current-main package trust API history and already engaged on this PR as the likely reviewer.
